# orchard_service_account (Resource)

Manages a service account in Orchard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "orchard" {
  token    = "your-service-account-token"
  base_url = "http://localhost:8080"
}

resource "orchard_service_account" "ci" {
  name  = "ci-bot"
  roles = ["admin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the service account.

### Optional

- `roles` (List of String) List of roles assigned to the service account.

### Read-Only

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Secret token used to access the API. Will be generated by the controller.

## Import

Import is not currently supported.
